Kar / Marissa,

Per our AP policy and tax compliance checklist: for foreign entities submitting a W-8BEN-E, we need one of the following before unfreezing a PO:

1) Valid W-8BEN-E with supporting government business registration or VAT/EORI number; OR
2) W-8BEN-E plus IRS validation (EIN confirmation) if payments will be routed through the US entity; OR
3) A signed Form 8233 only in specific vendor-customer arrangements (not applicable here).

Given Northwind’s note that they are foreign-owned, the W-8 is acceptable for withholding purposes, but we still need their official business registration number so our tax team can map the record and avoid erroneous 1099 processing. Please request a screenshot of the vendor’s registration page (or a PDF of the local registry) and any declared tax ID.

Marissa, hold the PO until we obtain the registry confirmation. If Northwind can provide a one-off invoice for services that fall under our pre-approved spend limits, we could consider a partial release; otherwise hold.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
